Swiss watch exports rose 9.1% in August to CHF 1,789.2 million, but the United States was the only major market to fall, down 19.4%. The UK gained 46.1% and France 113.5%, aided by an extra working day this year. Eight-month exports are up 1.7%. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Gold slipped to $4,310.70 an ounce this morning, and every metal on this paper's tape moved lower too. Silver fell 1.06% to $63.73, platinum 0.34% to $1,769.00, and palladium led, down 1.70% to $1,270.00, nearly four times gold's fall. Read at 04:59 ET vs Kitco's bid.
